name: script-progress-dashboard
description: One dashboard for your recurring jobs: did it run, what did it find, and is the trend improving. Live progress, run history, failure patterns and data-lineage. Local files only: no server, no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Quick Action buttons and tasks run shell commands defined in settings. In an untrusted workspace, buttons defined by the workspace's own settings are ignored and no command is run.

action.description: Label of the Quick Action to run (from scriptProgress.quickActions.buttons).

colors.description: Running task colour (progress bar, badge, map pulse).

walkthroughs.title: Script Progress Dashboard
walkthroughs.description: See what your scripts are doing without leaving the editor.

steps.title: See it working in 10 seconds
steps.description:
Run a simulated job that writes the same files a real script would.
[Simulate a Demo Run](command:scriptProgress.simulateRun)
Then watch the status bar and the Script Progress sidebar.

steps.title: Point it at your logs folder
steps.description:
Scripts write four small JSON files into one folder. Tell the dashboard where.
[Open Settings](command:scriptProgress.openSettings)

steps.title: Add five lines to a script
steps.description: Copy the reporter into your project and wrap a job with it. Type `progress` in a Python file for the snippet.

steps.title: Choose your sections
steps.description:
Every section is a switch. Keep the core ones in the sidebar and everything in the tab.
[Choose Dashboard Sections](command:scriptProgress.toggleSections)

steps.title: Wire buttons and a calendar
steps.description:
Quick Actions run your scripts from a button or `Terminal → Run Task`; the Process Calendar tells you what has not run yet.
[Open Dashboard](command:scriptProgress.openPanel)

scriptProgress.logsPath.markdownDescription: Folder holding `progress.json`, `run_history.json`, `deltas.json` and `access.json`. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder; absolute paths are used as-is.

scriptProgress.refreshInterval.description: Fallback poll interval in milliseconds. File changes are picked up immediately by a watcher; this catches anything the watcher misses.

scriptProgress.staleRunningMinutes.description: If a task still says 'running' but has not been updated for this many minutes, it is shown as STALLED (the script probably died without reporting).

scriptProgress.sections.summary.description: Summary strip at the top: runs today, failures, warnings, next due, stale scripts, metrics out of range.

scriptProgress.sections.activeTask.description: Active Task: progress, step, live elapsed, ETA, log tail, metrics; one card per running script.

scriptProgress.sections.warnings.description: Warnings raised by the running script (hidden automatically when there are none).

scriptProgress.sections.lastCompleted.description: Last Completed: status, duration, warnings and the metrics the script reported.

scriptProgress.sections.runHistory.description: Run History table with filters, sorting and click-to-expand detail.

scriptProgress.sections.processCalendar.description: Process Calendar: expected daily / weekly / monthly processes, whether they have run, month grids, SLAs.

scriptProgress.sections.timeline.description: Run Timeline: a Gantt-style strip of when each script ran over the last hours or days, with overlaps, failures and slow runs visible.

scriptProgress.sections.quickActions.description: Quick Action buttons that run commands in a terminal or as a task.

scriptProgress.sections.deltaTracker.description: Delta Tracker sparkline charts with thresholds.

scriptProgress.sections.metrics.description: Metrics Explorer: every value reported with Progress.metric(), per task across recent runs, with change vs the previous run.

scriptProgress.sections.warningTrends.description: Warning Trends: recurring warning messages grouped and counted, and warnings per day.

scriptProgress.sections.scriptHealth.description: Script Health: last run per script, result dots, failure rate, duration trend, stale detection.

scriptProgress.sections.pendingActions.markdownDescription: Findings your scripts marked `actionable=True`, taken from each script's most recent **successful** run. A failed run never clears an item.

scriptProgress.sections.impact.markdownDescription: Running totals of what your scripts have contributed, from `Progress.impact()`.

scriptProgress.pendingActions.maxAgeDays.description: Ignore actionable findings from runs older than this.

scriptProgress.coverage.show.markdownDescription: Show the coverage figure in the summary strip. It combines schedule adherence, run success and metrics-in-range, and always shows those inputs in its tooltip. It measures whether your jobs ran and what they reported — **not** the quality of the underlying data.

scriptProgress.runHistory.ignoreMetrics.description: Metric names to exclude from regression detection — anything naturally variable, such as a timestamp or an id.

scriptProgress.sections.accessMap.description: Access Map: which scripts touch which files, tables and services, drawn as a constellation with data lineage.

scriptProgress.dashboard.sectionOrder.description: Order of sections top to bottom. Sections not listed go last.

scriptProgress.dashboard.sidebarSections.markdownDescription: Sections to show in the **sidebar** (the narrow view). Empty = the same sections as the dashboard tab. Use this to keep only the core in the sidebar.

scriptProgress.dashboard.collapsible.description: Click a section title to collapse it; the choice is remembered.

scriptProgress.dashboard.density.description: Spacing and font size of the dashboard.

scriptProgress.activeTask.showLog.description: Show the last few log lines the script reported with Progress.log().

scriptProgress.activeTask.logLines.description: How many log lines to show.

scriptProgress.activeTask.showMetrics.description: Show metric chips reported with Progress.metric() while running.

scriptProgress.activeTask.showArtifacts.description: Show links to files the script reported with Progress.artifact().

scriptProgress.runHistory.filters.description: Show the search box and status chips above the table.

scriptProgress.runHistory.detail.description: Click a row to expand its warnings, metrics, resources and artifacts.

scriptProgress.runHistory.trend.description: Show a duration trend sparkline per task in Script Health and the detail row.

scriptProgress.runHistory.anomalies.description: Flag runs that took much longer than the task's usual duration (needs 3 prior runs).

scriptProgress.runHistory.anomalyFactor.description: A run is 'slow' when it takes at least this many times the task's median duration.

scriptProgress.timeline.windowHours.description: How many hours the timeline covers (24 = today, 168 = a week).

scriptProgress.timeline.showFailed.description: Draw failed runs (in the failure colour) as well as successful ones.

scriptProgress.metricsExplorer.maxRuns.description: How many recent runs per task to show as columns.

scriptProgress.metricsExplorer.metrics.description: Metric names to show. Empty = every metric any run reported.

scriptProgress.warningTrends.days.description: How many days of warnings to analyse.

scriptProgress.warningTrends.top.description: How many recurring messages to list.

scriptProgress.processCalendar.processes.markdownDescription: Expected processes. `name` is matched against the **start** of task names in run history, case-insensitively.

name.description: Prefix of the task name to match (e.g. 'Nightly Load' matches 'Nightly Load Phase 2').

dayOfMonth.description: Monthly only: the day by which the process is expected.

dayOfWeek.description: Weekly only: ISO weekday it is due by (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday). Default: end of the week.

dueHour.description: Daily only: hour (local) after which a missing run is overdue. Default 12.

maxMinutes.description: SLA: a run of this process longer than this is flagged as over its time budget (and notified when notifications.onSlow is on).

reminderDays.description: Notify when the due date is this many days away, instead of only once it has been missed. Fires once per due date.

subtasks.markdownDescription: Task-name prefixes of the phases this process is made of, when it is not one script. The process counts as done only once **every** phase has run successfully in the period; until then it shows `2 of 3 phases`. Leave it out for a single-script process.

scriptProgress.processCalendar.view.description: List of processes, a month grid per process, or both.

scriptProgress.processCalendar.complianc.description: Show how often each process has run over recent periods, as a row of dots with a percentage. Periods before a process first ran are shown hollow and excluded from the figure.
How many complete periods the compliance figure covers.

scriptProgress.processCalendar.upcoming.description: Show the 'next due' line under each process.

scriptProgress.quickActions.buttons.markdownDescription: Buttons. In `command`, write `${prompt:Your question}` anywhere you want to be asked for a value when the button is clicked.

command.description: Shell command. ${prompt:Label} tokens ask for input first. ${file} = the active editor's file.

cwd.description: Working directory (relative to the workspace folder). Default: the workspace folder.

task.description: The task name this button starts (so the button can show its last run and be disabled while it runs).

enableWhen.markdownDescription: Only offer this button when the last **successful** run says it is worth it — e.g. `{ "metric": "issues", "gt": 0 }` on a fix button. The button stays visible and is disabled with the reason, never hidden. If the metric or the run is missing, the button stays enabled.

task.description: Task whose last successful run is inspected. Defaults to this button's own 'task'.

metric.description: Metric name to read from that run.

scriptProgress.quickActions.runVia.markdownDescription: `terminal`: send the command to a reusable *Script Progress* terminal. `task`: run it as a VS Code task (appears in Terminal → Run Task, and the exit code is captured).

scriptProgress.quickActions.asTasks.description: Also expose every button as a VS Code task (type 'scriptProgress').

scriptProgress.quickActions.contextMenu.description: Add 'Run with Script Progress' to the Explorer and editor context menus for script files.

scriptProgress.quickActions.disableWhile.description: Disable a button while the task it starts (see 'task') is running.

scriptProgress.quickActions.interpreters.description: How 'Run with Script Progress' runs each file type (command prefix by extension).

scriptProgress.deltaTracker.metrics.description: Metric names from deltas.json to chart. Empty = every metric present.

target.description: The value this metric is aiming at. Drawn as its own line on the chart — an acceptable band is not the same thing as a goal.

scriptProgress.deltaTracker.thresholds.markdownDescription: Per-metric acceptable range and goal: `{ "reconciliation_delta": { "min": -0.5, "max": 0.5, "target": 0 } }`. Out-of-range values are highlighted and counted in the summary strip; the target is drawn as a separate line.

scriptProgress.deltaTracker.points.description: How many recent points to chart per metric.

scriptProgress.scriptHealth.staleHours.description: Hours after which a task with no run is considered stale (default 7 days).

scriptProgress.scriptHealth.resultDots.description: How many recent results to show as dots per task (0 = none).

scriptProgress.accessMap.maxNodes.description: Cap on nodes drawn (least recently seen are dropped first).

scriptProgress.accessMap.layout.description: force: physics-settled constellation. radial: scripts on an inner ring, resources on an outer ring grouped by type.

scriptProgress.accessMap.timeWindowDays.description: Only draw nodes and links seen in the last N days (0 = everything).

scriptProgress.accessMap.labels.description: Which labels to draw. auto = scripts always, resources when the map is small or on hover/focus.

scriptProgress.accessMap.sidebarPreview.description: Draw a small live preview of the map in the sidebar.

scriptProgress.accessMap.replay.description: When a run completes, replay its path through the map.

scriptProgress.accessMap.ambient.description: Traffic particles along the links a running script is using right now — script→resource for writes, resource→script for reads. Nothing moves when nothing is running.

scriptProgress.accessMap.halos.description: Soft coloured halos behind each script hub and its resources.

scriptProgress.accessMap.glyphs.description: Draw a small type glyph inside each node (script, table, file, service).

scriptProgress.accessMap.minimap.description: Show a mini-map inset with the current viewport when zoomed in.

scriptProgress.accessMap.starfield.description: A faint static starfield behind the map. Off by default; purely decorative and never animated.

scriptProgress.notifications.onComplete.description: Notify when a task completes successfully.

scriptProgress.notifications.onStall.description: Notify when a running task is detected as stalled.

scriptProgress.notifications.onWarning.description: Notify on each new warning while a task runs.

scriptProgress.notifications.onExit.description: Notify when a Quick Action's process exits with a non-zero code.

scriptProgress.notifications.onSlow.description: Notify when a run finishes far slower than usual or over its SLA (maxMinutes).

scriptProgress.notifications.mirrorProgr.description: Mirror the running task into a native VS Code progress notification with a percentage.

scriptProgress.metricsExplorer.totals.description: Show a total and mean per metric across the runs in view. Useful for anything worth accumulating, such as a per-run cost.

scriptProgress.events.file.markdownDescription: Write `last_event.json` into the logs folder whenever a run completes, fails, stalls or exits, so a tool outside VS Code can watch for it. Off by default: this is the only file the extension writes. It stays local — the extension makes no network requests of any kind.

scriptProgress.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the current task in the status bar.

scriptProgress.statusBar.idleMode.description: When nothing is running: show the last result, or hide the item.

scriptProgress.statusBar.clickAction.description: Clicking the status bar item opens a menu of actions, or the dashboard directly.

scriptProgress.badge.description: Number shown on the Activity Bar icon: running tasks, failed runs today, or nothing.
